guidance: Floor46 Slimed Berserker has261 HP and turn1 intent adds10 Status cards, not direct attack. HP64/81, energy4, Sai Block7, Decay curse in hand; initial attack cards are weak. Verified opening uses Clarity Potion to draw before status dilution, freeing a potion slot. If it draws Pyre+ or Barricade+, play those for a long fight if possible; Burning Pact can exhaust Decay/Status and draw. Do not waste the nonattacking first turn on only weak Strike or unneeded Block. After status insertion, defend against displayed attacks, thin dead cards, build sustained damage and use remaining Liquid Bronze, Block Potion and Flex Potion when they improve survival or a kill. Review after a bounded segment or at HP<=55. A Rest Site follows this fight before the Act3 boss.
